title: US not abandoning Taiwan for China deal, says Rubio
description: US President Donald Trump is expected to meet in the coming week with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Read more at straitstimes.com.

title: US won’t change Taiwan policy to get China deal, Rubio says before Trump-Xi talks
description: The US secretary of state says ‘no one is contemplating’ walking away from Taiwan in exchange for favourable treatment on trade.

title: Rubio says Taiwan need not worry about upcoming US-China trade talks
description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Sunday that Taiwan should not be concerned about upcoming US- China trade talks in Malaysia.

title: Rubio says Taiwan should not be concerned about US-China talks
description: U.S Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Sunday that Taiwan should not be concerned about upcoming U.S.-China trade talks in Malaysia.

title: Rubio Says US Will Not Change Taiwan Policy for China Trade Deal
description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that the Trump administration will not abandon long-standing US support for Taiwan in negotiations with China to reach a trade agreement.

title: China's Wang: Peaceful 'Reunification' With Taiwan Best Path
description: At the event at Beijing's Great Hall of the People, Wang also said China will take the lead in sharing the fruits of its development and progress with Taiwan's people, Taiwan's official Central News Agency said in a separate report datelined Beijing.

title: Top China official says peaceful 'reunification' with Taiwan is best path forward: Taiwan media
description: China's fourth-highest leader, Wang Huning, stated peaceful reunification with Taiwan is the best option. He emphasized China will not tolerate Taiwanese independence activities. Taiwan's government rejected China's message, calling it an attempt to annex the island. Taiwan celebrated a different historical anniversary, highlighting its commitment to freedom and democracy. The island's future remains a point of contention.

title: China’s reunification rhetoric vs Taiwan’s democratic defiance: What’s driving the latest flashpoint
description: China's fourthhighestranked leader said on Saturday that China and Taiwan should work to achieve "peaceful reunification", Chinese state news agency Xinhua reported

title: China's Peaceful Reunification Call for Taiwan: Mixed Reactions Highlight Historical Tensions
description: At a Beijing event marking Taiwan's restoration to Chinese control, a top Chinese leader urged peaceful reunification, warning against Taiwanese independence. Taiwan dismissed China's message as unappealing authoritarianism. Historical tensions persist, underscored by differing interpretations of a key WWII anniversary and Taiwan's resistance to Beijing's territorial claims.

title: Taiwan's Stand on Reunification: Unyielding in Face of China's Pressure
description: China's leadership proposed peaceful reunification with Taiwan, yet met with Taipei's resistance as leaders there emphasized autonomy and democratic values. Wang Huning's anniversary remarks highlighted Beijing's stance, but Taiwan celebrates its history of resisting communist invasion. Both sides remain at odds, underscoring longstanding territorial tensions.
